Should any non-numeric character (other than separators) immediately make the date invalid?
Is there a minimum or maximum valid year value?
Should the function return False (rather than raise an exception) for any malformed structure, such as a missing component?
Does the date string need to have exactly three components separated by hyphens, with nothing else?
